entries.1c7155b0271bb5c7: A business conducted by consolidated subsidiary Infodio Co., Ltd. It develops systems for insurance analysis and sales support and carries out contract software development, and also develops and sells products such as the AI-based "Smart OCR". Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥1,492 million.
entries.5ef267d9874674de: A business conducted by the company and its consolidated subsidiary Life Assist Co., Ltd. Through 108 directly operated stores (as of end-June 2026) of the walk-in insurance shop "Hoken Clinic", it sells insurance through consulting that uses the insurance analysis and search system "Hoken IQ System"; for the 199 franchise (FC) stores nationwide, it provides the system, education and training, and support for store operations. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥5,817 million.
entries.746b07ab430b7310: A business conducted by the company. It provides the life insurance status-grasping and search-proposal system "AS System" and the insurance application navigation system "AS-BOX" to financial institutions, insurance agencies and corporate agencies, and also provides insurance sales consulting and OCR services for financial institutions. The number of IDs as of end-June 2026 was 7,782 for insurance agencies and banks. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥1,378 million.

entries.c0fe2550b496ce76: A business conducted by the company and its consolidated subsidiary Life Assist Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥2,275 million.
